name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 6 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-10-09, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.65 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
